summary: The note describes the Pontifical Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary of Pompei, a Roman Catholic cathedral, Marian pontifical shrine and minor basilica in Pompei, Italy. It was commissioned by Bartolo Longo. The shrine is the see of the Territorial Prelature of Pompei.
one_line: A Roman Catholic Marian shrine, minor basilica and cathedral in Pompei, Italy, commissioned by Bartolo Longo and seat of the Territorial Prelature of Pompei.
key_facts: The Pontifical Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary of Pompei is a Roman Catholic cathedral.
The Pontifical Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary of Pompei is a Marian pontifical shrine.
The Pontifical Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary of Pompei is a minor basilica.
The Pontifical Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary of Pompei was commissioned by Bartolo Longo.
The Pontifical Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary of Pompei is located in Pompei, Italy.
The Pontifical Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary of Pompei is the see of the Territorial Prelature of Pompei.
